title: topology_hiding Module
content_markdown: This is a module which provides topology hiding capabilities. The module can work on top of the dialog module, or as a standalone module ( thus alowing topology hiding for all types of requests )
overview: This is a module which provides topology hiding capabilities. The module can work on top of the dialog module, or as a standalone module ( thus alowing topology hiding for all types of requests )

dependencies_required.name: Dialog Module
dependencies_required.reason: Required if “force_dialog” module parameter is enabled, or a dialog is created from the configuration script

exported_parameters.name: th_callid_passwd
exported_parameters.description: The string password that will be used for encoding/decoding the callid in case of topology\_hiding with callid mangling.

exported_parameters.name: th_callid_prefix
exported_parameters.description: The prefix that will be used for detecting callids which have been encoded by the dialog topology hiding. Make sure to change this value in case your SIP path contains multiple OpenSIPS boxes with topology hiding.

exported_parameters.name: th_passed_contact_uri_params
exported_parameters.default_value: empty - do not pass any parameters
exported_parameters.description: List of semicolon-separated Contact URI parameters that will be passed from one side to the other for topology hiding calls. To be used when end-to-end functionality uses such Contact URI parameters.

exported_parameters.name: th_passed_contact_params
exported_parameters.default_value: empty - do not pass any parameters
exported_parameters.description: List of semicolon-separated Contact header parameters that will be passed from one side to the other for topology hiding calls. To be used when end-to-end functionality uses such Contact header parameters.

exported_parameters.name: force_dialog
exported_parameters.description: If set to 1, the module will internally create the dialog ( if not already created ). This will only work for INVITE based dialogs, and the dialog module must be loaded.

exported_parameters.name: th_contact_encode_passwd
exported_parameters.description: When not relying on the dialog module ( due to script writer preference or simply when doing topo hiding for non INVITE dialogs ), the module will store the needed information in a Contact URI param. The parameter configures the string password that will be used for encoding/decoding that specific param .

exported_parameters.name: th_contact_encode_param
exported_parameters.description: When not relying on the dialog module ( due to script writer preference or simply when doing topo hiding for non INVITE dialogs ), the module will store the needed information in a Contact URI param. The parameter configures the respective parameter name.

exported_parameters.name: th_contact_encode_scheme
exported_parameters.description: When not relying on the dialog module ( due to script writer preference or simply when doing topo hiding for non INVITE dialogs ), the module will store the needed information in a Contact URI param. This parameter configures the encoding scheme to be used for the data stored in the Contact URI param.

exported_parameters.name: th_contact_caller_username_var
exported_parameters.description: Variable used to store the value of the contact username advertised to the caller.

exported_parameters.name: th_contact_callee_username_var
exported_parameters.description: Variable used to store the value of the contact username advertised to the callee.

exported_functions.name: topology_hiding

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: String flags to control topology hiding behavior.

parameters.name: contact_username
parameters.description: Advertise a particular username in the Contact header URI. Format: [caller_contact_username][/callee_contact_username].

exported_functions.description: By calling this function on an initial request, the modules will hide the topology, meaning that it will strip and restore all the Via, Record-Route and Route headers and it will replace the contact with the IP address of the interface where the request was received.

examples.description: Basic topology hiding usage on initial INVITE.
Topology hiding with 'U' flag to propagate username.
Set 'opensips' for both caller and callee Contact username.
Set specific usernames for caller and callee legs.

exported_functions.name: topology_hiding_match

parameters.name: dlg_match_mode
parameters.description: Dialog matching mode, behaves identically to match_dialog().

return_values.condition: if a topology hiding dialog exists for the request and the request has been successfully fixed.

exported_functions.description: This function is to be used to match and fix a sequential request belong to an existing topology hiding dialog. The in-dialog topology requests are requests with a to tag, RURI pointing to opensips and with a method specific to a Invite dialog.

examples.description: Matching sequential requests for topology hiding.
Handling sequential requests with error checking.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $TH_callee_callid
exported_pseudo_variables.description: Read only variable that will contain the callid as it is propagated towards the callee side, in case topology\_hiding("C") is called. NULL will be returned if there is no topology hiding dialog for the request or if topology\_hiding with callid encoding was not used for the current dialog.
